title: Statement of Work Signature and Rate Lock — Professional Services Projects
content:
For the signature of every Professional Services Projects statement of work, fixed-fee or time-and-materials, and only for such a signature, no change request is registered: the authorized contact e-signs the issued statement of work itself, the service desk never signs on the client's behalf, and a fixed-fee statement of work signed this way keeps the rate discount figured on its issue date. Change orders, termination notices, acceptance sign-offs and acceptance rejections are still registered by the service desk as change requests carrying the change order number, type, value change and new target date, pending the authorized contact's e-signature, and the service desk never signs any of them on the client's behalf.

## The rate discount a statement of work carries

Every statement of work carries from its issue date the rate discount figured on that date, which is the class ClearPath rate discount when, on the issue date, the client holds an active ClearPath agreement at or above the lowest ClearPath tier rank that earns the rate discount, and 0 otherwise. For a time-and-materials statement of work signed this way, and only for such a statement of work, that issue-date figure is provisional and the labor rate discount is locked on the signature date. A fixed-fee statement of work, and a time-and-materials statement of work that is not signed, keep the issue-date figure.

| Statement of work | Rate discount it carries |
|---|---|
| fixed fee, signed | the figure of its issue date |
| time and materials, not signed | the figure of its issue date, provisional |
| time and materials, signed | the labor rate discount locked on the signature date |

## Signing tool: `sign_statement_of_work_96bc6bf1`

**Capability.** The client's authorized contact e-signs a statement of work that is open for signature. The engagement moves to signed status, the signature date is recorded as today's date, and the labor rate discount locked by the signature is written to the engagement; the signed statement of work then shows the signed status, the signature date and the locked discount.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `sign_statement_of_work_96bc6bf1` for the customer (through `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`) and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it to e-sign.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the client reference number of the organisation whose authorized contact is signing, as returned by the client profile lookup | identifier |
| `project_engagement_id` | the reference number of the project engagement whose statement of work is being signed, as returned by the project engagement lookup | identifier |
| `rate_discount_pct` | the labor rate discount locked at signature, in percent | a non-negative decimal number with 1 decimal place |

**Return.** A confirmation string naming the client reference number, the engagement reference number, its new status (signed), the signature date in year-month-day form and the locked rate discount in percent with one decimal place; that string indicates the signature was recorded.
